info.title: Zooza API
info.description:
The Zooza API gives your integration access to a Zooza company's programmes, classes, sessions,
registrations, attendance and invoices.

## Regions

Each region has its own host (see the server list). A key works only in the region of the company
that created it.

## Authentication

Exchange your key's `client_id` and `client_secret`, together with the email of an owner of the
company, for an access token at `POST /v3/token`. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Tokens last 60 minutes and there is no refresh token: request a new one when it expires.

## Company

A key acts for the company that created it, and only for that company.

## Access groups

Each operation names the access groups that may call it and its cost in points (`x-zooza-access`, also
shown at the end of its description). A key holds one or more groups and may call the operations of all of
them. `GET /v3/me` lists everything your key may call.

## Rate limits

Every operation costs points from your company's budget per minute and per day, which all its keys share.
The budget comes from the company's rate tier (`x-zooza-tiers`). The `X-RateLimit-*` headers report it
**in points, not in requests**. Over budget, the API
answers `429` with `Retry-After`. `GET /v3/me` costs nothing and shows what is left.

## Dates and times

Dates and times are in the local time of your region, without an offset: EU `Europe/Bratislava`, UK
`Europe/London`, ASIA `Asia/Dubai`. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, date-times `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

## Amounts

Whether prices include VAT depends on the company's VAT setting. By default prices include VAT, and
VAT is calculated out of them. A company can instead enter prices without VAT, and VAT is then added
on top.

## Lists and pagination

Most lists share one envelope: `{total, page, page_size, settings, data}`, where `page` is zero-based,
`page_size` is the number per page and `data` holds the items (`GET /v3/events`, `/schedules`,
`/customer_invoices`, `/places`, `/users`). Three lists differ:

- `GET /v3/courses` returns a plain array of every programme, without pagination.
- `GET /v3/registrations` returns `{total, total_capped, page, offset, results}`: the items are in
  `results`, and `total` stops counting at 500 (`total_capped` says when).
- `GET /v3/calendar` returns `{settings, info, data}` for one date range, without pagination;
  `GET /v3/attendance` returns a plain array.

## Errors

- `401`, `403`, `422`, `429`, `503` and `504` use the `Error` body: `error`, `message`, `request_id`
  and, on `422`, `errors` with every problem found (up to 100).
- `400` uses the `RequestError` envelope: `errors` and `request_valid`, with messages in the company's
  language. Each entry maps a four-digit error code to its message. Branch on the code, not the message:
  codes never change meaning, messages are reworded and translated. Every code, with its English
  message, is listed in the error code reference (`x-zooza-error-codes` in this document).
- Any operation can also answer `404` with the `Error` body (no such path), or `500` with either body.
- `POST /v3/token` answers with OAuth error bodies (`error`, `error_description`).

## Field naming

Fields that start with `__` are copied from a related record or calculated by Zooza, so lists can be read
without extra requests. They are read-only: to change one, change the record it comes from.

| Pattern | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `__{record}__{field}` | `{field}` of a related record | `__courses__price` on a class is the price of its programme |
| `__calc__{name}` | A value Zooza calculates | `__calc__debt` on a registration is the total it has been charged |
| `__view__{name}` | A value shaped for display | |

Fields without the prefix belong to the record itself.

post.description:
OAuth 2.0 client-credentials grant. Send the body as JSON or form-encoded; `client_id` and `client_secret` may also come as HTTP Basic authentication, but `email` is always in the body.

`email` is the email of a user with the owner role in the key's company. The token acts as that owner, and a key can never do more than its owner may. Any current owner can be named. If that user stops being an owner, calls made with the token stop working.

The token lasts 60 minutes. There is no refresh token: cache the token, reuse it, and request a new one when it expires.

A refused exchange never says why. An unknown key, a wrong secret, a revoked key, an email that is not an owner of the key's company and a locked key all answer `401 invalid_client`. After 10 wrong secrets a key is locked for 5 minutes.

This operation has its own limit: 5 tokens per key and 20 per IP address per minute.

put.description:
Changes a session. What the request does depends on the body, checked in this order:

- `summary_public_locked`: locks or unlocks the public summary and returns `true`. Nothing else in the body is read.

- `summary`: saves the staff summary and returns `true`. Nothing else in the body is read.

- `summary_public`: saves the summary shown to clients and returns `true`. Nothing else in the body is read.

- Otherwise: the fields sent are changed and the session is returned.

`cancellation_reasoning`, `cancellation_reasoning_public` and `replacement_date` take effect only together with `status`. `place_id` and `room_id` must be sent together. Clients are emailed only when `notify` is true **and** the status, public cancellation reason, replacement date, instructor, venue or date changed.

Request validation checks types and the fields every operation of this endpoint requires. The fields a particular operation needs are checked when the request runs, and a missing one is answered with `400`.

Access group: `core_write` · Cost: 5 points.

put.description:
One endpoint for several operations. The request is checked in this order and the first match handles it:

1. `?action=preflight_check` with body `action: change_status`: previews the status change and writes nothing.
2. A `billing` object: changes the billing profile or bank account the registration invoices with. A body with only `billing` returns the registration's billing settings; with other fields as well, the request goes on to the next steps.
3. `notify_alternate_email` or `notify_alternate_email_only`: sets the alternate notification email and returns the registration. Nothing else in the body is read.
4. `?confirm_registration=1`: sets the status to `registered`, whatever it was, and returns `{status}`.
5. `slots`, `notify`, `business_order` or `notify_about_upcoming_events`: changes those and returns the registration. Nothing else in the body is read.
6. A body `action`: runs that one action (see `action`) and returns its result.
7. `actions`: runs several actions, in order.
8. `?confirm_late=1`: confirms a late registration.
9. Otherwise: changes the fields sent (`company_note`, `public_note`, `note`, `downpayment`, `downpayment_due`, `extra_replacements_limit`, `payments_managed_by`, `invoice_profile`, `vat_level`) and returns the registration.

Each field's description says which step or `action` reads it.

Request validation checks types and the fields every operation of this endpoint requires. The fields a particular `action` needs are checked when the request runs, and a missing one is answered with `400`. Compare the fields you sent with the description of the `action` you chose.

Access group: `core_write` · Cost: 5 points.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: The registration's id.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: `preflight_check`: preview a `change_status` (send the same body as the change itself) without writing anything. Any other body `action` is refused.

parameters.name: confirm_registration
parameters.description: `1`: sets the registration's status to `registered`, whatever it was, and returns `{status}`. Checked before any body `action`.

parameters.name: confirm_late
parameters.description: `1`: confirms a late registration (`late` becomes `registered`) and returns `{result: "confirmed"}`; any other status fails with `update_failed`. Applies only when the body has no `action`.

payments_managed_by.description: The registration that pays for this one (a registration id); `0` removes the payer. When sent, `invoice_profile` and `vat_level` are not read.

invoice_profile.description: Id of an invoice profile of the company; `null`, or an id that is not one, removes it.

vat_level.description: Id of one of the company's VAT levels; `null` resets it.

extra_replacements_limit.description: Make-up sessions this registration may take on top of the programme's limit.

note.description: The registration's note. With `action: set_attendance_note`: the note on the client's attendance at `event_id` (required).

billing.description: Only when changing how the registration is invoiced. `profile_id`: the billing profile; `bank_account_id`: a bank account of that profile. A key you send is applied (`null` or `0` goes back to the class's, programme's or company's setting); a key you leave out is kept. Refused for a registration paid for by another one (`payments_managed_by`).

notify_alternate_email.description: Another email address to send the registration's notifications to. Send it together with `notify_alternate_email_only`: the one you leave out is cleared.

notify_alternate_email_only.description: `true`: notifications go only to `notify_alternate_email`, not to the client's own address.

slots.description: Number of places the registration takes. Read only when greater than `0`.

notify_about_upcoming_events.description: Whether the client gets reminders about upcoming sessions (`1`) or not (`0`).

actions.description: Several actions to run in order, each an object with `action` and that action's fields. A cancellation reason at the top of the body applies to every `change_status` to `canceled` that has none of its own; if any such cancel lacks a valid reason, nothing runs.

cancellation_reason.description: With `action: change_status` to `canceled`: why the registration is cancelled (this or `cancellation_reason_id` is required). With `action: set_attendance`: the reason recorded with the attendance; sent without `attendance`, only the reason is changed.

cancellation_reason_id.description: With `action: change_status` to `canceled`: one of the company's cancellation reasons, instead of `cancellation_reason`.

action.description:
The action to run. Each needs its own fields:
* `set_attendance`: marks the client's attendance at session `event_id` (`attendance`). Returns `attendance`, `result` and the session's `remaining_capacity`.
* `set_attendance_note`: saves `note` on the client's attendance at `event_id`. Returns the note.
* `set_replacement`: books a make-up session: uses the registration's make-up credit `credit_id` on session `event_id`. Returns `events`, `attendance` and `credits`.
* `change_user_id`: moves the registration to the client `user_id`. Returns the registration.
* `change_customer`: makes `person_id` the registration's participant and refills the extra fields from that person. Returns `{res: true}`.
* `change_status`: changes the status to `status`, now or on `schedule_at`. Returns the registration.
* `resolve_trial`: sets the programme and class (`course_id`, `schedule_id`) the client continues in after the trial. Returns `{res: true}`.
* `revoke_scheduled_status_change`: cancels a status change scheduled with `schedule_at`. Returns the registration.
* `reset_nudge_state`: lets Zooza send session reminders again to a registration it had stopped sending them to. Returns the registration.
* `delete_attendance`: removes the make-up booking at session `event_id` and gives the make-up credit back. Only for programmes where clients book the whole class (`full2`). Returns `{result: {credit}}`.
* `register_to_segment` / `unregister_from_segment`: adds the registration to, or removes it from, the block `segment_id` of its class. Returns nothing.

event_id.description: The session. Required by `set_attendance_note`, `set_replacement` and `delete_attendance`; also read by `set_attendance`.

attendance.description:
With `action: set_attendance`: the attendance to record.
* `attended`: attended the session.
* `going`: plans to attend.
* `ignore`: hidden from the attendance overview. Zooza sets it for past sessions when a client moves to a class that has already started.
* `deleted`: a deleted attendance record. Zooza sets it, for example, when a make-up session is cancelled.
* `canceled`: the client cancelled.
* `hold`: on the waiting list for the session, in programmes where clients book single sessions (`registration_type: single`).
* `noshow`: did not attend.
* `waitlist`: make-up waiting list.

use_voucher.description: With `action: set_attendance`: pay for the session with one of the client's entry passes, if one is free.

replacement_pickup_preference.description: With `action: set_attendance`, when cancelling: when the client would like their make-up session.

replacement_pickup_note.description: With `action: set_attendance`, when cancelling: a note about the make-up session the client would like.

user_id.description: With `action: change_user_id`: the client to move the registration to. Required.

credit_id.description: With `action: set_replacement`: the make-up credit to use. Required; it must be a credit of this registration.

override_replacement_rules.description: With `action: set_replacement`: `true` books any session of the company, ignoring the programme's make-up rules.

person_id.description: With `action: change_customer`: the new participant. Required.

status.description: With `action: change_status` (and in a preflight check): the new status. Required.

convert_replacements_to_free_event.description: With `action: change_status` to `canceled`: how many of the registration's unused make-up credits the client keeps as free sessions. Default `0`.

schedule_at.description: With `action: change_status`: the date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) on which to make the change. Without it, the change is made now.

linking.description: With `action: change_status` (and in a preflight check): what to do with the registrations linked to this one. Required when cancelling a registration that has linked registrations; a preflight check lists the options.

email.description: With `action: change_status`: an email to send the client, with `subject`, `body` and `template`. Sent only when all three are given.

send_confirmation.description: With `action: change_status` to `canceled`: when present (any value), the client is emailed a cancellation confirmation, or, with `schedule_at`, the date the registration will be cancelled. It is sent whatever the new status is.

course_id.description: With `action: resolve_trial`: the programme the client continues in. Read only together with `schedule_id`.

__calc__current_value.description: Total value of the booking: `__calc__debt` plus the payment-plan instalments not charged yet. Negative when something is owed or due. In the booking's currency (`currency`).

__calc__additional_debt.description: Owed for additional sessions booked on top of the enrolment, kept apart from `__calc__debt`. Negative, or `0` when nothing is owed. In the booking's currency (`currency`).

__calc__additional_balance.description: Additional-session debt still uncovered after the booking's other debt is paid: money paid beyond `__calc__debt` covers it first. Negative while some is uncovered, `0` otherwise. In the booking's currency (`currency`).

linked_registrations.description: The other bookings of this booking's group (bookings made together, see `parent`): for the first booking of a group, the bookings under it; for a booking under another, the first booking and the rest of the group. A page of registrations shaped like this one.

buyer.description: The buyer: the person who made and pays for the booking (`__calc__buyer_person_id`), often a parent.

customer.description: The participant: the person who attends (`__calc__customer_person_id`), often a child. The same person as the buyer when the buyer attends.

user.description: The customer account that made the booking (`user_id`).

pending_identity_claim.description: The latest request to give this booking's participant their own customer account, which waits for the new email address to be verified: the open request, else the one that ended most recently. Fields: `claim_id`, `state` (`pending_verification`, `verified`, `completed`, `expired` or `cancelled`), `target_email` (masked) and `expires_at`. `null` when there is none.

application.description: The company's booking-widget links, for the application the booking was made through (the company's default widget application when unknown). `[]` when none.

refund_requests.description: Refund requests waiting for the company's decision on this booking. Empty when there are none.

billing.description: Billing profile and bank account resolution for this booking (resolved values and the inheritance chain).

id.description: Id of the booking's extra fields record. `0` when nothing has been saved for the booking yet.

registration_id.description: The registration these answers belong to (`GET /v3/registrations/{ID}`).

dob.description: Participant's date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`). `0000-00-00` or `null` when not given.

full_name.description: Participant's full name. Empty or `null` when not given.

address.description: Buyer's address as one line of text. When it was entered in parts, they are in `address_structured`.

business_name.description: Name of the business to invoice. Used when the registration's `business_order` is `true`.

business_address.description: Address of the business to invoice.

business_id.description: Registration number of the business to invoice.

tax_id.description: Tax identification number of the business to invoice.

vat.description: VAT number of the business to invoice.

created.description: When the extra fields were first saved.

updated.description: When the extra fields were last changed.

identification_number.description: Participant's personal identification number (for example a national ID or birth number).

extra_field_1.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 1: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_1` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_2.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 2: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_2` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_3.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 3: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_3` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_4.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 4: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_4` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_5.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 5: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_5` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_6.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 6: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_6` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_7.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 7: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_7` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_8.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 8: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_8` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_9.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 9: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_9` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_10.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 10: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_10` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_11.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 11: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_11` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_12.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 12: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_12` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_13.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 13: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_13` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_14.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 14: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_14` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

extra_field_15.description: Answer to the programme's custom extra field 15: the field whose `column_name` is `extra_field_15` in the programme's `extra_fields` (`GET /v3/courses/{ID}`), which holds its label and type. Stored as text; `null` when not answered.

citizenship.description: Participant's citizenship as a two-letter country code (for example `SK`).

address_structured.description: Buyer's address in parts: `address_1`, `address_2`, `city`, `zip`, `region` and `country`. `[]` when not given.

registration_slots_min.description: Minimum number of people one booking form must include. `1` unless the programme allows booking several people at once.

registration_slots_max.description: Maximum number of people one booking form can include. `1` unless the programme allows booking several people at once (for example a parent booking twins).

replacements_limit.description: Maximum number of make-up sessions one booking can use, on top of any extra limit granted on the booking itself. `0` = no limit.

custom_email.description: Id of the email template sent as the booking confirmation for this programme. `0` or `null` = the company's standard booking confirmation.

custom_email_event_notification.description: Id of the email template used for session reminders for this programme. `0` or `null` = the company's standard session reminder.

hide_before.description: Number of hours before a class starts when it stops being offered on the booking form. Applies only when `late_registrations` is `disabled`.

replacements_limit_per_events.description: With `flexible_replacements_limit` on, the number of sessions that `replacements_limit` applies to (for example 3 make-up sessions for every 5 sessions).

billable_events.description: Number of sessions in a class that are paid for. `0` = every session in the class counts (except deleted ones). Used with the `course_fee` price type.

replacement_time_limit.description: Number of days, counted from the end of the class (see `replacement_time_limit_type`), within which clients can use their make-up sessions. `0` = the company's general make-up expiry applies.

default_email_signature.description: Id of the email signature added to emails sent for this programme. `0` = the company's default signature.

custom_email_lead.description: Id of the email template sent to confirm a lead collection booking (a booking into a class with no session dates). `0` or `null` = the company's standard template.

constant_symbol.description: Constant symbol (a Czech and Slovak bank payment code) used in QR-code payment instructions.

specific_symbol.description: Specific symbol (a Czech and Slovak bank payment code) used in QR-code payment instructions.

trial_events_limit.description: Limit on the sessions offered for a trial: a number of days ahead when `trial_events_limit_type` is `date`, a number of sessions when it is `count`. Not used when the type is `none`.

downpayment_due_days.description: Number of days for the down payment deadline: days before the programme starts or days after the booking was created, depending on `downpayment_due_type`.

retention_notify_days_before.description: Number of days before a class ends when its clients are emailed about continuing (auto-enrolment). Used when `retention_type` is not `none`.

__calc__registrations_count.description: Number of bookings in the programme, in any status except deleted.

__calc__schedules_count.description: Number of classes in the programme, excluding deleted ones.

__calc__min_age.description: Minimum age, in months, allowed to book, derived from the date-of-birth extra field's age limit. `0` = no minimum.

__calc__max_age.description: Maximum age, in months, allowed to book, derived from the date-of-birth extra field's age limit. `2000` when the limit sets no maximum; `0` when no age limit was ever set.

trial_length.description: Length of a multi-session trial (`free_time_trial`, `paid_time_trial`): days or sessions, depending on `trial_length_type`.

priority.description: Display order of the programme for clients: programmes are sorted alphabetically, and a higher priority (0 to 1000) moves the programme up the list. Default `0`.

retention_days.description: Number of days a client whose class ended keeps seeing the auto-enrolment offer in their client profile. `0` = the default of 30 days.

delayed_start_max_days.description: Register now, start later: the maximum number of days after the earliest available date that a client may choose as their start. `0` = clients cannot choose a later start.

additional_sessions_limit.description: Maximum number of additional sessions one booking can buy. `0` = no limit.

additional_session_payment_deadline_days.description: Number of days a client has to pay for an additional session when `additional_session_payment_mode` is `enforced`. Only sessions starting at least this many days ahead can be booked.

priority_registration.description: Turns on priority registration: eligible returning clients can book before a class opens to everyone. See `priority_registration_offset`, `priority_registration_public_offset` and `priority_registration_audience`.

priority_registration_allow_multiple.description: With priority registration, keeps the class offered in a returning client's profile after they booked, so the same account can book more people (for example a parent booking several children).

cash.description: Turns on payment in cash and by bank transfer.

online_card.description: Turns on online card payment, through `online_card_provider`.

online_transfer.description: Turns on online bank transfer, through `online_transfer_provider`.

direct_debit.description: Turns on payment by direct debit, through `direct_debit_provider`.

public.description: Shows the programme in the catalogue of programmes on the company's website.

archive.description: Archives the programme: it is listed only among archived programmes.

online_registration.description: Allows online booking into the programme through the booking widget. When `false`, none of its classes can be booked online.

feedback_during_course.description: Sends clients a provisional feedback request while the class is running, once they have attended more than four sessions. Programmes booked for the full duration only.

feedback_after_course.description: Sends clients a feedback request after the class has ended.

hide_if_full.description: Hides a class from the booking form once it is full.

allow_replacements.description: Allows make-up sessions: clients who miss a session can attend another one instead. Programmes booked for the full duration only.

allow_custom_replacements.description: Allows tailored make-up sessions: instead of picking an existing session, the client proposes a time based on the instructor's working hours and availability.

auto_approve_custom_replacements.description: Confirms a tailored make-up session automatically when the instructor is free at the proposed time. When `false`, the instructor approves or declines each request.

allow_replacements_waitlist.description: Lets clients join the waiting list of a full session as a make-up session.

auto_waitlist_notification.description: Emails clients on the waiting list automatically when a place becomes available. Single-session programmes.

use_extra_fields.description: Adds the programme's extra fields (see `extra_fields`) to the booking form.

for_children.description: Marks the programme as being for children, which changes some booking form wording (for example "Parent's name" instead of "Name").

event_notification.description: Emails clients a reminder the day before each session.

allow_replacement_cancellation.description: Gives the client back their make-up entitlement when they cancel a booked make-up session. When `false`, a cancelled make-up session is lost.

admin_managed_replacements.description: Make-up sessions are assigned by an administrator: clients can still cancel a missed session, but cannot pick or change the make-up date themselves. Has effect only while `allow_replacements` is on.

upcoming_events_notification.description: Emails clients the day before about sessions available for booking. Pay-as-you-go programmes.

allow_replacements_from_other_companies.description: Lets clients of linked partner companies use make-up sessions in this programme. Which companies and sessions is set in `replacements_settings_other_companies`.

payment_schedule_is_mandatory.description: When `true`, a client booking a class that offers payment plans must choose one. When `false` and only one plan is offered, choosing it is optional.

allow_using_replacement_credits_as_disco.description: Lets clients use unused make-up session credits as a discount when booking a programme. Credits used this way are lost as make-up sessions.

flexible_replacements_limit.description: Applies `replacements_limit` per block of `replacements_limit_per_events` sessions instead of per booking, which suits classes that may be extended with more sessions.

allow_reschedule_of_replacements.description: Lets clients change an already booked make-up session. When `false` they can still cancel it.

limit_reschedule_to_once.description: Limits client rescheduling to once per session. Rescheduling by instructors or administrators does not count.

payments_managed_by_buyer.description: When several people are booked at once, the debt of the other bookings moves to the first booking, and any payment plan is created on the first booking only. The person booking gets one payment reference and one confirmation email.

track_attendance.description: Tracks attendance. When `false`, make-up sessions and session reminders are not available. Programmes booked for the full duration.

force_full_first_installment.description: With payment in instalments, charges a full instalment together with the first, prorated one. When `false`, only the prorated amount is charged first.

reserve_seat_for_trial_attendees.description: Keeps the place a trial client used until they book the full programme or the trial is marked lost. Not applicable when `trial_events_capacity` is `extra_capacity`.

widgets_published.description: Whether the owner has marked the programme as published on their website, a step of the programme setup checklist. Does not affect booking.

allow_rescheduling_of_events.description: Lets clients reschedule their sessions themselves, within the instructor's working hours.

auto_approve_rescheduled_events.description: Approves client requests to reschedule a session automatically. When `false`, the instructor approves or rejects each request.

automatically_add_schedules_to_trial.description: Offers every newly created class of the programme for trials. Can be changed per class.

automatically_add_schedules_to_retention.description: Offers every newly created class of the programme to clients in auto-enrolment. Can be changed per class.

reviews_after_registration.description: Asks clients for a Google review after they book.

reviews_after_first_session.description: Asks clients for a Google review after their first attended session.

reviews_after_class_ended.description: Asks clients for a Google review after their class has ended.

allow_additional_sessions.description: Lets clients buy additional sessions, on top of those their booking covers, from their client profile. Programmes booked for the full duration only.

allow_cancellation_discount.description: When a client cancels an additional session, offers a discount code instead of a refund.

direct_debit_provider.description: Direct debit provider: `manual` (mandates managed by the company, SEPA), `go_cardless` (GoCardless) or `fastpay` (FastPay, UK BACS).

online_card_provider.description: Online card payment provider: `stripe` (Stripe via Zooza), `stripe_connect` (the company's own Stripe account), `global_payments` (Global Payments), `gp_webpay` (GP webpay), `tatra_banka` (Tatra Banka via Zooza, Slovakia) or `tatra_banka_cz` (Tatra Banka via Zooza, Czech Republic). Which ones a company can use depends on its region.

name.description: Programme name, shown to clients in the booking form.

url.description: Address of a web page where clients can find out more about the programme.

get_extra_fields_from.description:
Extra fields are required for:
- all: Every person
- other: Every person but registrant (first person)

get_basic_fields_from.description:
Basic fields ( First name, last name, email, phone ) are required for:
- all: Every person
- registrant: Just first person

registration_type.description:
How clients book the programme:
- `full2`: booking for the full duration; the client is enrolled in every session of the class. Make-up sessions, trials and instalments are available.
- `open`: pay-as-you-go; the client books each session separately.
- `single`: a one-off event with one session.

course_type.description: Kind of programme: `course` (a programme with instructors and sessions), `event` (sessions with speakers or lectures), `online_event` (online sessions with speakers or lectures) or `photography`.

description.description: Programme description, also shown during online booking.

late_registrations.description:
What happens to bookings made after a class has started:
- `disabled`: not allowed.
- `confirmation_required`: the booking must be confirmed manually.
- `auto_approve`: the booking is confirmed automatically, priced according to `aliquot_settings`.

custom_label_note.description: Custom label of the note field on the booking form. Empty = the default label.

custom_label_first_name.description: Custom label of the first name field on the booking form. Empty = the default label.

custom_label_last_name.description: Custom label of the last name field on the booking form. Empty = the default label.

custom_label_email.description: Custom label of the email field on the booking form. Empty = the default label.

custom_label_phone.description: Custom label of the phone field on the booking form. Empty = the default label.

collect_feedback_start.description: Only bookings created after this date are sent feedback requests. `null` = no feedback requests are sent.

collect_reviews_start.description: Clients who booked before this date are not asked for a Google review.

iban.description: IBAN shown in bank-transfer payment instructions for this programme, copied from its invoice profile or, without one, from the company. See also `billing`.

iban_account_holder.description: Account holder name for `iban`, copied with it.

color.description: Colour of the programme in calendars, as a colour name (for example `nicoll_blue`).

replacement_time_limit_type.description: Whether `replacement_time_limit` counts the days before (`before`) or after (`after`) the end of the class.

price_type.description:
How the price of a programme paid in instalments works:
- `course_fee`: term payment; the price is the session price (`unit_price`) times the sessions left in the class, split into instalments.
- `membership`: a fixed amount per instalment, however many sessions take place.
- `legacy`: the older pricing model, based on `price`.

direct_debit_mandate_id_format.description: Pattern for generating direct debit mandate references, built from tokens. `direct_debit_mandate_id_rules.tokens` lists the tokens and their meaning.

aliquot_settings.description:
How the price of a booking made after the class started is calculated:
- `automatic`: from the number of sessions left in the class.
- `automatic_days`: from the days left in the current period plus one full period.
- `no_value`: nothing is charged until the next period starts.
- `full_price`: always the full price.

money_collection.description: How clients pay for the programme: `one_off` (in one payment) or `installments` (in scheduled payments, see `price_type`).

trial_events_capacity.description: Which places trial clients can take: `all` (any free place in the class) or `extra_capacity` (only the extra capacity set on the class).

retention_type.description:
What is offered to clients when their class ends (auto-enrolment):
- `none`: nothing.
- `suggest_schedules`: a choice of suitable classes, filtered by `retention_settings`; the client continues with one click.
- `duplicate_schedule`: for 1-to-1 classes, a copy of the current class is prepared for the next period.

retention_message.description: Message sent to clients when their class is ending and auto-enrolment is available.

trial_events_limit_type.description: How the sessions offered for a trial are limited: `none` (no limit), `date` (sessions within `trial_events_limit` days) or `count` (the first `trial_events_limit` sessions with free capacity).

trial_type.description:
Trial offered for the programme:
- `none`: no trial.
- `free_trial`: one free session.
- `paid_trial`: one paid session, at `unit_price_trial`.
- `free_time_trial`: free access to sessions for the trial length (`trial_length`).
- `paid_time_trial`: paid sessions for the trial length.
- `lead_collection`: the trial booking is created without a session; the company enrols the client into a trial session itself.

code.description: Product code (SKU) the programme is reported under, one of the company's product codes. `null` when not set.

__calc__available_currencies.description: Currencies other than the company's standard one that clients can pay this programme in, each with its exchange `rate`.

downpayment.description: Down payment: `none`, `relative` (a percentage of the price, `downpayment_value`, capped at `downpayment_cap`) or `absolute` (a fixed amount, `downpayment_value`).

downpayment_due_type.description: What the down payment deadline (`downpayment_due_days`) counts from: `before_course` (days before the programme starts) or `after_registration` (days after the booking was created).

__calc__registration_url.description: Address of the booking form for this programme, on the company's default booking widget page. Empty when the company has no default booking widget page.

trial_length_type.description: Unit of `trial_length`: `days` (the client is enrolled in available sessions for that many days after their first trial session) or `events` (that many sessions).

registration_display_mode.description:
Booking options the booking form offers:
- `default`: the client chooses.
- `full_course_only`: only booking the full programme.
- `trials_only`: only trials, if available.
- `segments_only`: only blocks, if available.
- `trials_and_segments_only`: trials or blocks, if available.

target_audience.description: Whether the programme runs group classes (`groups`) or 1-to-1 classes (`individuals`).

direct_debit_scheme.description: Direct debit scheme that follows from `direct_debit_provider`: `bacs` for `fastpay`, otherwise `sepa`.

additional_session_pricing_mode.description: Price of an additional session: `free`, `regular_unit_price` (the regular session price) or `custom` (`additional_session_unit_price`).

additional_session_payment_mode.description: Whether paying for an additional session is enforced: `open` (the charge is added to the booking balance and the client keeps the session) or `enforced` (the client must pay within `additional_session_payment_deadline_days`, otherwise they are removed from the session and the charge is cancelled).

payment_mode.description:
How clients pay for sessions they book online in a pay-as-you-go programme:
- `pass_first`: an entry pass while they have one, then payment.
- `passes_only`: only with a valid entry pass; without one the booking is refused.
- `payment_only`: every session is paid; entry passes are never used.
- `both`: the client chooses for each session.

deleted_at.description: When the programme was deleted. A deleted programme can still be loaded by id. `null` for a programme that is not deleted.

unit_price.description: Price of one session. Used by pay-as-you-go programmes and by programmes paid in instalments.

price.description: Total price of the programme. Used when payment is collected in one go (`money_collection` = `one_off`) and by single-session programmes; with payment plans it is for reference only. `__calc__price` is the price actually applied.

registration_fee.description: Registration fee, charged when the booking is created and added to the programme price or the first scheduled payment.

__calc__fee_cash.description: Payment processing fee on `price` for cash and bank transfer payments, calculated from the company's fee rates when the price was last saved.

__calc__fee_online_card.description: Payment processing fee on `price` for online card payments, calculated from the company's fee rates when the price was last saved. `0` when online payments are off.

__calc__fee_online_transfer.description: Payment processing fee on `price` for online bank transfers, calculated from the company's fee rates when the price was last saved. `0` when online payments are off.

__calc__fee_direct_debit.description: Payment processing fee on `price` for direct debit payments, calculated from the company's fee rates when the price was last saved. `0` when online payments are off.

__calc__price.description: Price applied to bookings, without the registration fee: `price` when payment is collected in one go, otherwise the session price (`unit_price`).

downpayment_value.description: Down payment: a percentage of the price when `downpayment` is `relative`, a fixed amount when it is `absolute`.

downpayment_cap.description: Maximum down payment amount when `downpayment` is `relative`. `0` = no cap.

unit_price_trial.description: Price of one paid trial session. `0` = the regular session price (`unit_price`).

additional_session_unit_price.description: Price of one additional session when `additional_session_pricing_mode` is `custom`.

replacements_settings.description: Where clients can use their make-up sessions: which programmes, billing periods and venues. Returned as an empty array `[]` when not set, which means no restriction.

additional_sessions_settings.description: Which sessions clients can book as additional sessions, in the same shape as `replacements_settings`. Returned as an empty array `[]` when not set.

replacements_settings_other_companies.description: Which linked partner companies, billing periods, venues and classes are open to make-up sessions from other companies (see `allow_replacements_from_other_companies`). Returned as an empty array `[]` when not set.

retention_settings.description: Filters for the classes offered to this programme's clients in auto-enrolment when `retention_type` is `suggest_schedules`: programmes (`courses`), billing periods, age and distance. Returned as an empty array `[]` when not set.

priority_registration_audience.description: Who is eligible for priority registration: clients booked in the listed programmes (`courses`) or billing periods. Returned as an empty array `[]` when not set, which means no narrowing.

schedule_start_date_format.description: How the booking widget shows a class start date: an `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options object. `null` = the default format.

schedule_end_date_format.description: How the booking widget shows a class end date: an `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options object. `null` = the default format.

direct_debit_mandate_id_rules.description: Rules a mandate reference must follow under `direct_debit_scheme`: `scheme`, `max_length`, allowed characters (`charset`), `no_leading_space`, `not_all_identical`, and the `tokens` usable in `direct_debit_mandate_id_format`.

direct_debit_mandate_id_rules_by_provide.description: The same rules as `direct_debit_mandate_id_rules`, for every direct debit provider, keyed by provider.

priority_registration_offset.description: Number of days before the billing period starts (or the class starts, when the period has no start date) when priority registration opens. Resolved for each class. `null` when not set.

priority_registration_public_offset.description: Number of days before the billing period starts (or the class starts) when a priority class opens to everyone. `null` = it never opens to the public.

onboarding.description: Which programme setup steps the owner has answered: `{"version": 2, "answered": {...}}` with one boolean per step, or, for an older programme, `{"version": 1, ...}` with the six legacy checklist booleans.

extra_fields.description: Extra fields (custom booking form fields): one entry for every field type Zooza offers, set up on this programme or not, in form order. `active` says whether a field is on the booking form; the form shows them only while `use_extra_fields` is on.

billing.description: Billing profile and bank account resolution for this programme (resolved values and the inheritance chain). Detail endpoint only.

labels.description: Labels attached to the programme (paginated collection). List endpoint only.

started.description: Whether the programme has started. List endpoint only.

schedules.description: The programme's classes. List endpoint only.

course_id.description: Id of the programme the class belongs to.

time.description: Start time of the class's first scheduled session, in minutes after midnight (e.g. `540` = 09:00). `0` when the class has no scheduled sessions.

duration.description: Length of a session, in minutes.

place_id.description: Id of the venue where the class takes place.

room_id.description: Id of the room within the venue; `0` when no room is set.

registrations_cap.description: Maximum number of registrations the class accepts, independently of seats: one registration can hold several seats. When it is reached, the class is no longer offered in booking forms. `0` means no limit.

capacity.description: Number of seats in the class.

extra_capacity.description: Extra seats on top of `capacity`, used for make-up sessions and, when the programme places trial attendees in extra capacity, for trials. How it combines with the company-wide extra capacity is set by `extra_capacity_usage`.

total_events.description: Number of scheduled sessions in the class.

__calc__total_avg_nps_score.description: Average NPS score (0–10) of the class's answered feedback requests, as a whole number (decimals are dropped).

__calc__total_requests.description: Number of feedback requests counted for the class's NPS figures.

__calc__registered.description: Seats taken by registrations with status `registered` or `pre_registered`, plus seats of trial attendees (`trial_started`, `trial_ended`, `pre_trial_started`) when the programme reserves a seat for trial attendees.

__calc__waitlist.description: Seats held by registrations on the waiting list (status `waitlist` or `pre_waitlist`).

__calc__late.description: Seats held by late registrations (status `late` or `pre_late`).

trainer_rate_type_id.description: Id of the instructor pay rate used for the class's sessions; `0` when none is set.

__calc__remaining_events.description: Number of scheduled sessions that have not started yet.

billable_events.description: Number of sessions the class is priced for (billable sessions). `0` means not set on the class: the programme's setting applies, and if that is not set either, the number of sessions in the class.

__calc__events__elapsed.description: Number of scheduled sessions whose date has passed.

__calc__events__total.description: Number of sessions with status `scheduled` or `unplanned`.

__calc__events__total_custom_replacement.description: Number of scheduled sessions added as custom make-up sessions.

__calc__events__total_billable.description: Number of scheduled sessions marked as billable.

__calc__events__elapsed_billable.description: Number of scheduled billable sessions whose date has passed.

__calc__events__total_nonbillable.description: Number of scheduled sessions not marked as billable.

__courses__billable_events.description: Copied from `billable_events` of the related programme; read-only.

__calc__nps_promoters.description: Share of the class's feedback requests with an average score of 9–10 (promoters), in percent.

__calc__nps_detractors.description: Share of the class's feedback requests with an average score of 0–6 (detractors), in percent.

__calc__nps.description: Net Promoter Score of the class: `__calc__nps_promoters` minus `__calc__nps_detractors`, rounded (−100 to 100).

__calc__min_age.description: Minimum participant age, in months, taken from the programme's date-of-birth age limit. `0` means no minimum.

__calc__max_age.description: Maximum participant age, in months, taken from the programme's date-of-birth age limit. A large value (`1000` or `2000`) means no maximum.

__calc__segments.description: Number of the class's active blocks that can be booked online.

__calc__trial_not_started.description: Seats held by trial registrations whose trial has not started yet (status `trial_not_started` or `pre_trial_not_started`).

__calc__trial_started.description: Seats held by trial registrations whose trial is in progress (status `trial_started` or `pre_trial_started`).

__calc__trial_ended.description: Seats held by trial registrations whose trial has ended without an outcome yet (status `trial_ended` or `pre_trial_ended`).

__calc__trial_won.description: Seats held by trial registrations that converted (status `trial_won` or `pre_trial_won`).

__calc__trial_lost.description: Seats held by trial registrations that did not convert (status `trial_lost` or `pre_trial_lost`).

deleted_by_user_id.description: Id of the user who moved the class to the trash; `0` when the class is not deleted.

__calc__has_shared_sessions.description: Whether at least one of the class's sessions shares a room with a session of another class (a shared session, whose seats are pooled and capped by the room).

__calc__effective_capacity.description: Registration capacity of the class: the smallest seat limit across its active sessions, where a shared session is capped by the room's capacity. When no session has a limit yet, `capacity` + `extra_capacity`.

glue_set_id.description: Id of the shared-room set the class has opted into; `0` when none. Filled only when a single class is requested by id; always `0` in lists.

start.description: Start date of the class (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Follows the first scheduled session unless set by hand (`custom_start`).

end.description: End date of the class (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Follows the last scheduled session unless set by hand (`custom_end`).

extra_capacity_usage.description: How `extra_capacity` combines with the company-wide extra capacity from the general settings. `add`: both are added together. `override`: only the class's `extra_capacity` is used.

status.description: `active`: the class is running. `archive`: archived. `deleted`: in the trash.

description.description: Description of the class shown to clients during booking.

notify_trainer_on_cancellation.description: When the instructor is emailed about a client cancelling attendance at a session. `always`: every time. `never`: never. `week`: only when the session is within the next 7 days.

__calc__debt_updated.description: When the class's income figures (`__calc__possible_income`, `__calc__booked_income`, `__calc__debt_*`) were last recalculated.

__courses__price_type.description: Copied from `price_type` of the related programme; read-only.

__courses__money_collection.description: Copied from `money_collection` of the related programme; read-only.

__courses__registration_type.description: Copied from `registration_type` of the related programme; read-only.

__calc__registration_url.description: Link to the company's default booking form with this class preselected. Empty when the company has no booking form.

schedule_type.description: Kind of class. `fixed_period`: runs between a start and an end date. `rolling`: ongoing, with no fixed period. `lead_collection`: an enquiry listing without sessions; sign-ups are leads, not bookings.

segments_config.description: Block discount settings: `discount_mode` (`simple` or `advanced`) and `discount_settings`. `simple` scales the discount linearly from `min_segments` to `max_segments` booked blocks, up to `max_discount`; `advanced` lists the discount per number of booked blocks in `discounts`. `null` when not configured: each block's own discount applies.

online_meeting_id.description: Meeting id of the class's online meeting (just the id, not the full link); `null` when the class has none.

online_meeting_provider.description: Platform of the class's online meeting: `google_meet` or `zoom`; `null` when the class has none.

deleted_at.description: When the class was moved to the trash; `null` when it is not deleted.

status_before_delete.description: The class's `status` before it was moved to the trash, restored if the class is restored; `null` when it is not deleted.

__view__admin_url.description: Link to the class in the Zooza admin; `null` when not available.

priority_registration_phase.description: Phase of the programme's priority-registration window for this class. `priority`: only eligible returning clients can see and book it. `public`: it has opened to everyone (final; it never goes back). `null`: the window has never applied to this class.

__view__priority_registration_start.description: Date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) the priority-registration window opens for this class, worked out from the programme's settings and the start of the class's billing period (or the class's own start). `null` when the programme has no priority window or the date cannot be worked out.

__view__priority_registration_public_sta.description: Date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) this class opens to everyone after the priority window. `null` when the programme has no priority window, when the class never opens to the public, or when the date cannot be worked out.

all_day.description: Whether the class's sessions are all-day (no start time).

public.description: Whether the class is listed in the company's booking forms. A class that is not public is not offered online.

online_registration.description: Whether clients can book the class online. During a priority window it is `false` until the class opens to everyone.

in_trial.description: Whether the class offers trial sessions. The programme's trial settings must allow trials too.

in_retention.description: Whether the class is offered to clients through auto-enrolment (as a follow-up when their current class ends). The programme's auto-enrolment settings must allow it too.

custom_start.description: Whether `start` was set by hand. When `false`, `start` follows the first scheduled session.

custom_end.description: Whether `end` was set by hand. When `false`, `end` follows the last scheduled session.

lead_collection_money_collection_enabled.description: For `lead_collection` classes only: whether payment is collected from sign-ups. Ignored for other classes.

__view__registration_url_active.description: Whether `__calc__registration_url` currently leads to a bookable class: `online_registration` is on and `status` is `active`.

priority_registration.description: Whether the class is part of its programme's priority-registration window. When `false`, it opens to everyone on the normal schedule.

unit_price.description: Price per session set on the class, in the company's currency. `0` means not set: the programme's price per session applies.

price.description: Total price set on the class, in the company's currency. `0` means not set: the programme's price applies.

registration_fee.description: Registration fee set on the class, in the company's currency. `0` means not set: the programme's registration fee applies.

__calc__possible_income.description: Income if every seat were sold: the class's full price times `capacity`, in the company's currency.

__calc__booked_income.description: Total charged to all of the class's registrations that are not deleted, including waiting-list and late registrations, in the company's currency (positive).

__calc__debt_issued.description: Total charged to the class's current registrations (statuses `registered`, `pre_registered`, `guest`, `pre_guest`, `canceled`), as a negative amount in the company's currency.

__calc__debt_paid.description: Total paid by the class's current registrations (same statuses as `__calc__debt_issued`), in the company's currency.

__calc__debt_balance.description: `__calc__debt_paid` + `__calc__debt_issued`: negative while money is still owed, `0` when settled, positive when overpaid.

__calc__price.description: Full price of the class, without pro-rating, after falling back to the programme's price where the class sets none, in the company's currency.

__calc__unit_price.description: Price per session used for the class, after falling back to the programme's values (derived from the total price where the programme charges one), in the company's currency.

__calc__registration_fee.description: Registration fee that applies to the class: its own, or the programme's when the class sets none, in the company's currency.

__courses__unit_price.description: Copied from `unit_price` of the related programme; read-only.

__courses__price.description: Copied from `price` of the related programme; read-only.

__calc__current_price.description: Price of booking the class now, with the programme's pro-rating for sessions already held applied, in the company's currency. `0` when the class has sessions but none remain.

__courses__registration_fee.description: Copied from `registration_fee` of the related programme; read-only.

__courses__schedule_start_date_format.description: The programme's display format for the class start date: an `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options object (e.g. `{"dateStyle": "long"}`). `null` means the default format.

__courses__schedule_end_date_format.description: The programme's display format for the class end date: an `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options object. `null` means the default format.

billing_periods_schedules.description: The link between this class and its billing period (`billing_period_id`).

trainer.description: Only on `GET /schedules/{ID}`: the class's main instructor (`trainer_id`) as a user.

billing.description: Only on `GET /schedules/{ID}`: the class's billing settings, i.e. which billing profile and bank account its invoices use and whether they are set on the company, the programme or the class itself. Change them with `billing` on `PUT /schedules/{ID}`.

course_id.description: Id of the programme the session belongs to.

schedule_id.description: Id of the class the session belongs to.

place_id.description: Id of the venue where the session takes place.

room_id.description: Id of the room within the venue; `0` when no room is set.

summary_filled_by.description: User id of the person who last edited the internal session note (`summary`); `0` when it was never edited.

summary_public_filled_by.description: User id of the person who last edited the public session summary (`summary_public`); `0` when it was never edited.

trainer_rate_type_id.description: Id of the instructor pay rate type used to calculate the instructor's pay for this session; `0` when none is set.

__calc__attendance__going.description: Seats taken on the session: clients marked as going or attended, plus clients of a full-programme class who have no attendance record for the session yet and are expected by default. Includes make-up and free sessions and clients visiting from other companies. Counts seats, not people: one registration can hold several.

__calc__attendance__canceled.description: Seats whose attendance at this session was cancelled.

__calc__attendance__waitlist.description: Seats on the waitlist for this session.

__calc__attendance__attended.description: Seats marked as attended. These are also counted in `__calc__attendance__going`.

__calc__attendance__ignore.description: Seats of registrations to which this session does not apply, for example because the client joined later, left the programme or the registration was cancelled. Such clients are not shown on the session.

__calc__attendance__deleted.description: Seats whose booking on this session was removed, for example a cancelled make-up session.

__calc__attendance__hold.description: Clients on the waiting list for this session, in programmes where clients book single sessions (`registration_type: single`).

duration.description: Length of the session in minutes; `0` means the class's duration applies.

__calc__event_number.description: Position of the session among the class's scheduled sessions in date order, starting at `1`; `0` for a cancelled session.

replaced_by.description: Id of the replacement session created when this session was cancelled and moved to a new date; `0` when none.

replacement_for.description: Id of the cancelled session this session replaces; `0` when it is not a replacement session.

canceled_by.description: User id of the person who cancelled the session; `0` when the session is not cancelled or was cancelled automatically.

rescheduled_by.description: User id of the client whose request to reschedule this session was approved; `0` when the session was never rescheduled on request.

live_stream.description: Id of the live stream attached to the session; `0` when none.

video_expires_in.description: Number of days after which the session's videos are hidden from clients, counted from the moment set in `video_expiry`; `0` means they never expire.

original_trainer_id.description: User id of the originally assigned instructor when a substitute teaches the session (`substituted`); `0` otherwise.

deleted_by_user_id.description: User id of the person who deleted the session. Deleted sessions are not returned, so this is `0`.

__calc__effective_capacity.description: Seat capacity of this session: the room's capacity when the session is a shared session in a room with a capacity set, otherwise the class's capacity. `null` when not yet calculated; use the class's capacity then.

name.description: Optional name of this session, separate from the programme and class names; `null` when not set.

summary.description: Internal session note, visible to the company's team only; `null` when empty.

summary_public.description: Session summary shared with the clients who attended; `null` when empty.

status.description: Session status: `scheduled` — the session takes place; `unplanned` — the session was cancelled. Deleted sessions are not returned.

date.description: Start date and time of the session, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, in the region's local time (see *Dates and times*).

created.description: Date and time the session was created, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

updated.description: Date and time the session record last changed, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

summary_filled_at.description: Date and time the internal session note was last edited, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `null` when never edited.

summary_public_filled_at.description: Date and time the public session summary was last edited, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `null` when never edited.

__calc__event_trainer.description: Display name of the session's instructor: the nickname alone when the instructor shows only a nickname, otherwise `Nickname (First Last)` or `First Last`. For a placeholder instructor (an id above 9000000000000) it is that id.

__calc__event_place.description: Display label of the session's venue: venue name, room name when set (`Venue - Room`), street, region and city, separated by commas.

video_expiry.description: What `video_expires_in` counts from: `event` — the session date; `registration` — the date the client booked.

canceled_at.description: Date and time the session was cancelled, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `null` when not cancelled.

cancellation_reasoning.description: Internal reason the session was cancelled, for the company's team; `null` when none was given.

cancellation_reasoning_public.description: Reason for the cancellation shown to clients and included in the cancellation notice; `null` when none was given.

__schedule_segments__name.description: Names of the class blocks the session belongs to, separated by `|`, in the same order as `__schedule_segments__id`; `null` when it belongs to no block.

__schedule_segments__id.description: Ids of the class blocks the session belongs to, separated by `|`; `null` when it belongs to no block.

original_date.description: Start date and time the session had before it was first rescheduled at a client's request, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `null` when it was never rescheduled that way.

deleted_at.description: Date and time the session was deleted. Deleted sessions are not returned, so this is `null`.

status_before_delete.description: Status the session had before it was deleted. Deleted sessions are not returned, so this is `null`.

__calc__glue_key.description: Identifier of the shared session this session is part of: sessions of several classes running in the same room, on the same date, at overlapping times, treated as one so the room is not double-booked. Sessions with the same value are the same shared session. `null` when the session is not part of a shared-sessions set.

is_custom_replacement_event.description: `true` when the session was created as a tailored make-up session: a date a client proposed for a make-up session and the instructor approved. Only clients booked onto it attend; the class's other clients are not expected.

summary_public_locked.description: `true` when the public session summary can no longer be filled in. When the company requires instructors to complete session summaries, a summary still empty two days after the session is locked automatically; the owner can unlock it.

billable.description: `true` when the session is marked as one the company charges for. Used with the class's billable-sessions setting; when no session of a class is marked, all of them count as billable. Cleared when the session is cancelled automatically for having no attendees.

substituted.description: `true` when a substitute instructor teaches this session in place of the original one (`original_trainer_id`).

trainer_payout_percentage.description: Share of the instructor's rate paid for this session, from `0` to `1` (`1` = full pay, `0.5` = half). Set to `0` when the session is cancelled.

course.description: The programme this session belongs to.

schedule.description: The class this session belongs to.

__calc__replacement_for__date.description: Start date and time of the cancelled session this session replaces (`replacement_for`), `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `null` when it is not a replacement session. Returned only when reading a single session.

__calc__replaced_by__date.description: Start date and time of the replacement session created for this cancelled session (`replaced_by`), `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `null` when none. Returned only when reading a single session.

__calc__canceled_by__full_name.description: First and last name of the person who cancelled the session (`canceled_by`); `null` when not cancelled by a person. Returned only when reading a single session.

event_credit_applied.description: `true` when a credit for this session has been applied to its clients' upcoming scheduled payments, lowering what they will be charged. A session can be credited once. Returned only when reading a single session.

event_debit_applied.description: `true` when an extra charge for this session has been added to its clients' upcoming scheduled payments. A session can be charged once. Returned only when reading a single session.

glue_key.description: Same value as `__calc__glue_key`: the identifier of the shared session this session is part of, or `null`.

glued_with.description: The other classes' sessions that form one shared session with this one (same room, date and overlapping time). Each item has `event_id`, `schedule_id`, `course_id`, `class_name`, and the `schedule` (class) and `course` (programme) objects. Empty when the session is not shared on this date.

is_glued.description: `true` when the session actually shares the room with at least one other class's session on this date, that is when `glued_with` is not empty. A session of a shared-sessions set that runs alone is `false`.

SessionAttendance.description: One attendee of a session. Financial fields are `null` for callers without financial visibility.

id.description: Id of the client's attendance record for this session; `0` when there is none yet (a client of a full-programme class is expected at every session without one).

event_id.description: Id of the session the attendance record belongs to; `0` when there is no record. On a shared session this can be another class's session in the same shared session.

cancellation_reason.description: Reason the client gave for cancelling this session, as a code such as `sickness`, `travel` or `notprovided` (no reason provided); `null` when none.

replacement_for.description: For a make-up booking: id of the missed session it replaces; `0` otherwise.

attendance.description: The client's attendance status for this session: `going`, `attended`, `noshow` (did not attend), `canceled`, `canceled_late` (deprecated, no longer recorded), `waitlist` or `hold`. `null` when there is no attendance record yet; a client of a full-programme class is then expected to attend.

moved.description: `true` when the client's registration belongs to a different class than this session (on a shared session: to none of the sharing classes), for example a client attending a make-up session here.

replacement.description: `true` when this booking is a make-up session (`replacement_for` is set).

credit_id.description: Id of the make-up credit linked to this booking: for a make-up booking, the credit used to book it; otherwise the credit created from this attendance, for example when the client cancelled the session. `0` when none.

is_free_event.description: `true` when the client attends this session as a free session, granted with a free-session credit. A free session counts whatever the status of the registration.

type.description: Kind of booking: `regular`, `make_up`, `free_event`, `additional_session` (a purchased extra session) or `waitlist`. `null` on older records that are not classified; use `replacement`, `is_free_event` and `attendance` for them.

waitlist_credit_id.description: On a make-up waiting-list booking (`type: waitlist`): the make-up credit the client used to join the waiting list. A client can wait for several sessions with one credit; when one of them gives the client a place, the other waiting-list bookings with the same credit are removed.

user_id.description: User id of the client account that made the registration.

full_name.description: First and last name of the client account that made the registration. The participant's own name is `ef_full_name`.

email.description: Email address of the client account that made the registration.

phone.description: Phone number of the client account that made the registration.

paid.description: Amount paid on the registration, as a whole number (decimals are cut off). `payment_paid` has the exact amount.

slots.description: Number of seats the registration holds.

attendance_management.description: How the client may manage attendance: `default` — full (mark attendance, cancel sessions and choose make-up sessions); `king_of_schedule` — the client is the class's "king of the class": when they cancel a session it is cancelled for every client of the class, and they choose the make-up session; `limited` — another client is the king of the class, so this client cannot cancel sessions or choose make-up sessions.

registration_status.description: Status of the registration, for example `registered`, `trial_started` or `canceled`.

calc__unused_replacements.description: Number of make-up credits of the registration that are not yet used. Can be up to an hour out of date.

payment_balance.description: Payment balance of the registration in its currency: amount paid minus amount charged. Negative means the client still owes money, `0` settled, positive overpaid.

payment_debt.description: Total charged on the registration in its currency, as a negative number, including scheduled future instalments.

payment_paid.description: Total paid on the registration in its currency.

__calc__paid.description: Total paid on the registration in its currency; same as `payment_paid`.

payment_status.description: Payment status of the registration, for example `paid`, `partially_paid`, `unpaid`, `overpaid` or `no_debt`; `null` when not set.

currency.description: Currency code of the registration when it differs from the company's currency; `null` when the company's currency applies.

currency_rate.description: For a registration paid in an alternative currency the programme accepts: the exchange rate the company set between that currency and its own. `0` when the registration is in the company's own currency.

__calc__buyer_person_id.description: Id of the person who made the booking (the buyer); see `buyer`.

__calc__customer_person_id.description: Id of the person who attends (the participant); see `customer`.

ef_dob.description: Participant's date of birth, `YYYY-MM-DD`; `null` when not collected.

ef_full_name.description: Participant's full name as entered at booking; `null` when not collected.

ef_address.description: Participant's address as entered at booking; `null` when not collected.

replacement_in.description: Id of the make-up session the client booked in place of this session; `0` when none.

internal_note.description: The company's internal note about the client; `null` when empty.

email_verified.description: `true` when the client account's email address is verified; `null` when there is no client account.

email_rejected.description: `true` when emails to the client account's address are rejected (bounced); `null` when there is no client account.

phone_verified.description: `true` when the client account's phone number is verified; `null` when there is no client account.

extra_fields.description: The registration's extra field values, keyed by field, each with its `value` and the programme's `custom_label`.

buyer.description: The person who bought the booking.

trial_event_ids.description: For a trial registration: ids of the sessions the registration has attendance records on, which are its trial sessions. Empty for other registrations.

other_company_attendance.description: When the client attends a make-up session at another company in place of this session: one item with `company_name` (the company hosting it) and `replacement_for` (this session's id). Empty otherwise.

entrance_voucher.description: Entry-pass state of the client: `user_id`, `unused_entrance_vouchers` (the client's unused entry passes at this company) and `credit_id` (the entry pass redeemed for this booking, or `null`). `null` when the client has no entry passes.

video_statistic.description: For a session with videos: the client's viewing progress per video, each with `name`, `progress`, `updated` (when the progress last changed) and `video_count`. Empty when the session has no videos.

google_forms_summary.description: Google Forms submission summary. Returned only to callers who may read submissions.

CalendarSession.description: One session in the calendar. A rescheduled session whose original date is also in the requested range appears twice: the actual occurrence (`is_actual: true`) and the original slot (`is_actual: false`).

course_id.description: Id of the programme the session belongs to.

schedule_id.description: Id of the class the session belongs to.

capacity.description: Seat capacity of the class the session belongs to (class level, not this session's own capacity).

event_number.description: Position of the session among the class's scheduled sessions in date order, starting at `1`, so `event_number` of `total_events`; `0` for a cancelled session.

registrations.description: Seats taken in the class: for a session that belongs to an active block, the seats held in that block; otherwise the seats registered in the class.

canceled.description: Seats whose attendance at this session was cancelled.

free_event.description: Seats taken by clients attending this session as a free session.

attended.description: Seats taken on the session: clients marked as going or attended, plus clients of a full-programme class who are expected by default. Despite the name, not only clients who attended.

url.description: Path of the session in the Zooza app, `courses/{course_id}/events/{id}`.

date.description: Date of the session, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in the region's local time (see *Dates and times*).

time.description: Start time of the session, `HH:MM`, in the region's local time (see *Dates and times*); `07:00` for an all-day class.

date_time.description: Start date and time of the session, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:00`, in the region's local time (see *Dates and times*); the time is `07:00` for an all-day class.

trainer.description: Name of the session's instructor, last name first; `null` when the instructor is a placeholder.

place.description: Display label of the session's venue: venue name, room name when set (`Venue - Room`), street, region and city, separated by commas.

place_short.description: Venue name, or `Venue - Room` when a room is set.

trainer_id.description: User id of the session's instructor.

duration.description: Length of the session in minutes: the session's own duration, otherwise the class's; `660` for an all-day class.

room_id.description: Id of the room within the venue; `0` when no room is set.

event_name.description: Optional name of this session, separate from the programme and class names; `null` when not set.

event_status.description: Session status: `scheduled` — the session takes place; `unplanned` — the session was cancelled (returned only when cancelled sessions are requested).
