course_color.description: Colour of the programme, used to colour the calendar.

attendance_count.description: Seats with recorded attendance: attended plus cancelled plus no-show.

total_attendance.description: Seats on the session including cancellations: taken (`attended`) plus cancelled plus no-show, minus removed bookings.

has_public_summary.description: `true` when the public session summary has been filled in.

pid.description: Venue and room as `{place_id}_{room_id}`; the same value can be passed as the `pid` filter.

is_custom_replacement_event.description: `true` when the session was created as a tailored make-up session: a date a client proposed for a make-up session and the instructor approved. Only clients booked onto it attend; the class's other clients are not expected.

billable.description: `true` when the session is marked as one the company charges for. Used with the class's billable-sessions setting; when no session of a class is marked, all of them count as billable. Cleared when the session is cancelled automatically for having no attendees.

has_online_meeting.description: `true` when the class has a Zoom or Google Meet online meeting set up.

registration_type.description: How clients book the programme: `full2` — for the full programme duration, signed up for every session; `open` — pay-as-you-go, signed up for each session individually; `single` — a one-off event.

canceled_by.description: User id of the person who cancelled the session; `0` when the session is not cancelled or was cancelled automatically.

all_day.description: `true` when the class runs all day; `time` is then `07:00` and `duration` `660`.

original_date.description: Start date and time the session had before it was first rescheduled at a client's request, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `null` when it was never rescheduled that way.

is_original_in_range.description: `true` when `original_date` falls within the requested date range.

is_actual_in_range.description: `true` when the session's current date (`date_time`) falls within the requested date range. `false` for a rescheduled session returned only because its original date is in range.

is_actual.description: `true` for the session at its current date. `false` for the extra copy that marks a rescheduled session's original slot; that copy is otherwise identical, so place it by `original_date`, not `date`.

invoice_profile_id.description: Id of the invoice profile (the issuer's billing identity) the invoice was issued under. `0` means the company's own details.

order_id.description: Id of what the invoice is for: a registration id when `order_type` is `course`, an order id when it is `product`.

company_id.description: Id of the company that issued the invoice.

box_id.description: Id of the invoice's PDF copy in Zooza's document storage; `0` when no copy has been stored.

invoice_buyer_id.description: Id of the saved buyer (billing) details chosen for this invoice; `0` when none was chosen and the default buyer details apply.

invoice_series_id.description: Id of the extra invoice series that numbered the invoice; `null` for the default series.

order_type.description: What `order_id` refers to. `course`: a registration. `product`: an order.

engine_return_code.description: The invoicing provider's identifier for the issued document; `null` until the invoice has been issued.

engine_error_code.description: Error message from the last failed attempt to issue the invoice; `null` when the last attempt succeeded or none was made.

engine_data.description: The data sent to the invoicing provider for the last successful attempt, or the error details of the last failed one; `null` before any attempt. Its shape depends on `engine`.

invoice_no.description: Invoice number assigned by the invoicing provider, without the series; `null` until the invoice has been issued. See `display_number` for the number as shown on the document.

created.description: When the invoice record was created.

updated.description: When the invoice record was last updated.

invoice_data.description: The invoice content as issued: supplier (`d`), buyer (`o`), invoice details (`f`) and items (`p`). Its exact keys depend on `engine`.

options.description: Settings chosen when the invoice was requested.

delivery_date.description: Delivery date printed on the invoice (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

text.description: Text of the item on the invoice.

payment_method.description: Payment method printed on the invoice. `hotovost`: cash. `prevod`: bank transfer. `karta`: card. `eprovider`: online payment provider.

period_start.description: Start of the billing window the invoice covers (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). The invoice lists the payments recorded within the window.

period_end.description: End of the billing window the invoice covers (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, inclusive). The next invoice for the same registration or order starts the day after.

engine.description: Invoicing provider that issues the invoice. `faktury_online` is Zooza's default invoicing.

engine_response.description: The invoicing provider's response to issuing the invoice, as a JSON string; its shape depends on `engine`. `null` until the invoice has been issued.

currency.description: Currency of the invoice (ISO 4217 code, e.g. `EUR`); `null` when not known yet.

invoice_series_name.description: Current name of the extra invoice series in `invoice_series_id`; `null` for the default series.

display_number.description: Invoice number as shown on the document, including the series where the provider uses one (e.g. `ZOO 0042`); `null` until the invoice has been issued.

display_number_file.description: `display_number` made safe for file names: characters other than letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` become `-`. `null` when there is no number.

total_net.description: Total of the invoice without VAT, in `currency`; `null` when the invoice has no content yet.

total_gross.description: Total of the invoice including VAT, in `currency`; `null` when the invoice has no content yet.

has_document_url.description: Whether the invoice can be opened in the invoicing provider's system.

field_order.description: Position of the field on the booking form, ascending. `0` for a field not set up on this programme.

column_name.description: Which field this is. Built-in fields: `dob` (date of birth, can carry an age limit), `full_name` (the attendee's full name, for example a child), `address`, `slots` (how many guests the attendee brings, e.g. for birthday parties, where the company caps the number of bookings with the class\'s `registrations_cap`; guests are counted, not named), `identification_number`, `citizenship`; business fields for invoicing a business: `business_name`, `business_address`, `business_id`, `tax_id`, `vat`; custom fields the company names itself: `extra_field_1` to `extra_field_15`.

name.description: Name of the field: its custom label on this programme when one is set, otherwise the field's default name (for example `Date of Birth`).

description.description: Default description of the field type, in English. May be empty.

custom_label.description: Label of the field on this programme's booking form; the default name when the company set none. `null` for a field not set up on this programme.

active.description: Shows the field on the booking form (while the programme's `use_extra_fields` is on).

mandatory.description: Makes the field required on the booking form. Which people in a multi-person booking must fill it in follows the programme's `get_extra_fields_from`.

field_options.description: Settings of the field, depending on `column_name`: for `dob` the age limit; for `address` `{"format_type": "simple" | "structured"}`; for a custom field `{"type": "text" | "choice", "items": [{"key": …, "value": …}]}` with the options of a choice field. `[]` or `null` when not set.

ExtraFieldAgeLimit.description:
Age limit is used with field `dob` to limit values submitted within this extra field.
###Limit types
There are three possible types:
    1. `none` - limit is not used
    2. `date` - date range is used for validation. Submitted value must be formated as date string
    3. `age` - age range is used for validation. Submitted value must be formatted as integer
###Limit units
If limit type is set to `age`, limit unit describes whether submitted integer is considered to be in years or months
###Limit usage
Limit usage defines range that is used for validation:
    1. `both` - both minimum limit and maximum limits are used. That means that submitted value must fall between these two values
    2. `min`- only minimum value of limit is used. For example if minimum limit is set to 3 months, then any number equal or larger than 3 will pass the test
    3. `max`- the opposite of minimum value
###Minimum and maximum limit values
Depending on limit type this can either be a number (in case of age) or date string (in case of date)

age_limit_type.description: How the age limit is checked: `none` (no limit), `date` (the date of birth must fall within a date range) or `age` (the age at booking must fall within a range, in `age_limit_units`).

age_limit_min.description: Lower bound, inclusive. With `age_limit_type` `age`: the minimum age, a number in `age_limit_units`. With `date`: the earliest allowed date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`), so it sets the oldest person who may book.

age_limit_max.description: Upper bound, inclusive. With `age_limit_type` `age`: the maximum age, a number in `age_limit_units`. With `date`: the latest allowed date of birth (`YYYY-MM-DD`), so it sets the youngest person who may book.

age_limit_exceeded.description: What happens when the person is outside the limit: `deny` (the booking is refused) or `allow` (the booking is accepted, optionally put on the waiting list or labelled, see `age_limit_status` and `age_limit_label`). Missing = `deny`.

age_limit_status.description: With `age_limit_exceeded` `allow`: `waitlist` puts a booking outside the limit on the waiting list (trial bookings excepted); empty = no change of status.

age_limit_label.description: With `age_limit_exceeded` `allow`: id of the label attached to a booking outside the limit. `0` = no label.

question_active_during.description: Includes the question in the provisional feedback request sent while the class is running.

question_active_after.description: Includes the question in the feedback request sent after the class has ended.

is_mandatory.description: The client must answer a mandatory question to submit the feedback form. It is always part of the programme's feedback and cannot be removed from it.

name.description: The question. For Zooza's built-in questions this is a key (for example `company_rating`, `trainer_rating`, `note`) to be shown as translated text; for a question the company wrote, its own text.

type.description: Kind of answer: `nps` (a 0 to 10 rating) or `text` (free text).

Agreement.description:
Agreement will contain masked fields if it is not requested by eligible user.
Masked fields:
    - company_id
    - order
    - mandatory
    - valid_from
    - type
    - for
    - apply_for
Also only following types of agreements are returned:
    - checkout
    - registration
    - feedback

order.description: Denotes order in which the agreement will appear in the form

region.description: Two-letter lowercase region code the agreement text applies to (e.g. `sk`, `gb`). A company is shown the agreements of its own region; where none exist for that region, the `gb` ones apply.

name.description:
Name is shown in the registration form. This is the name of the agreement
and can contain *|AGREEMENT_URL|*. If present, this var needs to be replaced with url: https://agreements.zooza.app/{ID}.
Should you want to display agreement inline within the registration form, use also Title and Description for full text of the agreement.

title.description: Title is shown to user when displaying agreement's detail.

description.description: Description is shown to user when displaying agreement's detail.

mandatory.description:
All mandatory agreements need to be posted back to API (with full object containing title, description and name).
Non-mandatory agreements should be sent only when given consent (e.g. Radio button is selected or checkbox is selected). 1 = mandatory, 0 = optional.

valid_from.description: Date from which this agreement version is valid

type.description:
Type of form input used to give consent with agreement.
*none: No input is used. The consent is given by clicking the Register button
*radio: Yes and No options are shown to user. If mandatory, any one of those two choices need to be selected
*checkbox: Checkbox is shown to user. If mandatory, checkbox needs to be checked

for.description:
Denotes to which application this agreement is targeted.
*registration: When doing POST/registrations
*checkout: When doing POST/orders
*feedback: When doing POST/feedback_requests

category.description: What the consent is for; shared by every version of the agreement. `system`: a Zooza platform consent. `general`: unclassified (the default). `terms`: terms and conditions, house rules and declarations. `privacy`: personal-data processing notice. `marketing`: permission to send marketing. `media`: photo and video capture and publication.

created.description: When this agreement version was created.

updated.description: When this agreement version was last updated.

apply_for.description:
*everyone: The agreement is always shown
*course: Agreement is required only for courses that match course_ids within courses property
*feedback: Feedback form
*members: Internal consents for company members

sites.description: `true`: the agreement is shown on the forms of the company's Zooza Sites website.

logo.description: Logo URL of the company the agreement belongs to.

company_id.description: Id of the company the venue belongs to.

events.description: Number of scheduled sessions at the venue dated from 6 months ago to 1 year ahead. Recalculated daily.

upcoming.description: Number of scheduled sessions at the venue in the next 3 months. Recalculated daily.

region.description: Area of the city the venue is in (free text).

created.description: When the venue was created (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

modified.description: When the venue was last modified (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

status.description: Status of the venue. `active`: in use. `inactive`: switched off. `deleted`: deleted. Lists return `active` venues unless a `status` filter is given.

subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the region whose holidays are skipped when sessions are scheduled at the venue, together with national holidays (e.g. `SK-BL`). `null` or empty when not set.

place.description: Display label of the venue: `name`, `street`, `region` and `city` joined with commas, skipping empty parts.

pid.description: Venue reference in the `{place_id}_{room_id}` form used by booking-form filters, with room `0` (the whole venue), e.g. `12_0`.

__calc__registration_url.description: Link to the company's default booking form filtered to this venue. Empty when the company has no booking form.

instructions.description: Directions to help clients find the venue.

google_review_link_status.description: Link between the venue and a Google Business Profile location, used for review requests. `unlinked`: no location. `unverified`: linked to a location that Google has not verified yet, so there is no review link. `linked`: linked to a verified location; `google_review_url` is set.

google_location_resource.description: Google Business Profile resource name of the linked location (`accounts/{account}/locations/{location}`); `null` when unlinked.

google_review_url.description: Link where clients can leave a Google review of the venue; set only when `google_review_link_status` is `linked`.

google_location_title.description: Name of the linked Google location, as last read from Google.

google_location_address.description: Address of the linked Google location, as last read from Google.

google_linked_at.description: When the Google link was last written (linked, submitted to Google, or its verification status refreshed); `null` when the venue is unlinked.

latitude.description: Latitude of the venue, in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the venue, in decimal degrees.

id.description: Id of the billing period. Classes refer to it as `billing_period_id`.

company_id.description: Id of the company the billing period belongs to.

name.description: Name of the billing period, e.g. `Autumn 2026` or `2026/2027`.

period_start.description: First day of the billing period (`YYYY-MM-DD`). `null` when not set.

period_end.description: Last day of the billing period (`YYYY-MM-DD`). `null` when not set.

created.description: When the billing period was created (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

modified.description: When the billing period was last modified (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

active.description: Whether the billing period is active. Classes can be filtered by it (`billing_period_active` on `GET /schedules`).

created.description: When the user account was created (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

updated.description: When the user account was last updated (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`).

avatar.description: URL of the user's profile picture; `null` or empty when none is set.

email_verified_at.description: When the user verified their email address; `null` when not verified.

phone_verified_at.description: When the user verified their phone number; `null` when not verified.

feedback.description: Whether the user agrees to receive feedback requests (NPS surveys and review requests). When `false`, none are sent.

email_verified.description: Whether the user has verified their email address.

phone_verified.description: Whether the user has verified their phone number.

email_rejected.description: Whether email to the user's address bounced or was rejected. While `true`, no email is sent to the user. Cleared when the address changes.

role.description: The user's membership in the requesting company (role, created, updated).

The user's role in the company. `owner`: company owner. `main_member`: main instructor. `member`: instructor. `external_member`: external instructor. `assistant`: assistant. `receptionist`: receptionist. `customer`: client. `inactive`: deactivated staff member. `inactive_customer`: deactivated client. Users with an inactive role cannot sign in to the company.

created.description: When the user joined the company.

updated.description: When the membership was last changed (for example the role).

CompanyId.description: ID of company that record belongs to

InstructorId.description: Trainer_ID is a synonym to User_ID

error.description: A stable machine code, e.g. `validation_failed` or `rate_limited`.

request_id.description: Identifies the request. Also returned as the `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when you contact support.

errors.description: On `422` only: every problem found, not only the first (up to 100).

location.description: Where the problem is: the body, the query string or the path.

path.description: A JSON Pointer into the body (e.g. `/participants/0/email`), or the name of the query or path parameter.

code.description: What is wrong, as a stable machine code.

message.description: The problem in words, in English.

expected.description: The rule that was broken, e.g. `{"maximum": 200}`.

received.description: What was sent: its type and, except for secret-looking fields, its value (truncated to 100 characters).

error.description: `invalid_request`: a field is missing. `unsupported_grant_type`: `grant_type` is not `client_credentials`. `invalid_client`: the credentials were not accepted (no reason is given).

TokenRequest.description: The credentials to exchange for an access token.

grant_type.description: Optional. The only accepted value is `client_credentials`.

client_secret.description: The key's secret, shown once when the key was created or its secret rotated. Read it from your environment; never put it in code.

email.description: The email of an owner of the key's company. The token acts as that owner.

scope.description: The key's access groups, space-separated, e.g. `core_read core_write`.

Me.description: What the key may do and how much of its company's point budget is left.

region.description: The region the key belongs to.

tier.description: The company's rate tier, the same for all its keys.

points.description: The company's point budget, shared by all its keys.

remaining_minute.description: Points left in the current minute.

reset_day.description: When the daily budget resets (midnight UTC).

token.description: The token this request was made with.

operations.description: Every operation this key may call.

op.description: The operation id, as in this reference.

path.description: The path, with placeholders such as `{ID}`.

RequestError.description: The request failed. HTTP 400 with the error codes and localised messages. What each code means: [error code reference](https://docs.zooza.online/api/error-codes).

Status401.description: The access token is missing, invalid or expired. Request a new one from `POST /v3/token`.

Status403.description: This operation is outside the key's access groups. `GET /v3/me` lists everything the key may call.

Status422.description: The request does not match this operation's schema. `errors` lists every problem found.

Status429.description: Over the company's point budget (shared by all its keys). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds.

Status503.description: The API is temporarily unavailable. No points were charged; retry later.

Status504.description: The API did not answer in time. No points were charged; retry later.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Points per minute for this key.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Points left in the current minute.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the minute budget resets.

X-RateLimit-Limit-Day.description: Points per day for this key.

X-RateLimit-Reset-Day.description: Seconds until the daily budget resets.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.
